Article 6.1: Evaluation Account Resets

Warren's summary

Summarize this rule
When Do You Need to Reset?
You breached the trailing drawdown (account balance hit or went below the drawdown floor)
You exceeded the maximum allowed contract limits
You choose to reset voluntarily to start fresh
How to Reset an Evaluation Account

Evaluation accounts can be reset directly through your FFN Dashboard. Resets on Max accounts are $100 and Steady account resets are tiered accordingly (see table below). Discounts are available daily in the FFN Discord server.

Log in to your dashboard.
Navigate to your evaluation account.
Select the reset option.
Pay the reset fee.
Your evaluation restarts with the original balance and parameters.
An account reset on or after October 22, 2026 follows the payout caps (Article 5.3) and the high-frequency trading rule (Article 3.8) for accounts purchased on or after October 22, 2026.
